verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs say it embeds stored text automatically and lets you customize the embedding model ([chroma-docs-1], [chroma-docs-21]). Queries can take raw query texts, so the same embedding happens at query time ([chroma-docs-2]). Supported providers include OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face and sentence-transformers ([chroma-docs-12]). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in embedding flow, and in-depth documentation of how providers are configured (credentials, where embedding runs, switching models).
